campaign: NequIP CHORUS Pearl three-rung causal replication
implementation_revision: v2: nonzero phase-row initialisation; Full/Aligned separation and nonzero phase-gradient tests required

modes.off: Unmodified NequIP aggregation; no CHORUS parameters.
modes.diagonal: CHORUS parameter schema retained, but only j=k Hermitian self-density terms are contracted.
modes.aligned: Complete j,k Hermitian closure with all learned phases set to zero; parameter schema is identical to Full.
modes.full: Complete j,k Hermitian closure with learned U(1)-structured phases.

test_rule: evaluate only the checkpoint selected by validation Force MAE
energy_calibration: train-only elemental residual for zr-o; no validation or test fitting
paired_estimands: diagonal - off: self-density augmentation (parameter count is a documented co-intervention)
aligned - diagonal: cross-neighbour Hermitian closure without learned phase contrast
full - aligned: learned U(1) phase contrast at identical parameter schema
notes: The earlier Slurm array 57448 was invalidated because zero phase initialisation trapped Full at the Aligned stationary point; none of its outputs are used.
Energy and Force validation envelopes are reported independently and are never presented as one checkpoint.
OpenEquivariance is intentionally disabled in this mechanism experiment so every mode uses the same reference backend.
Production throughput comparisons remain based on the optimized OpenEquivariance implementation.
